clusters.name: Your grandfather Gordon's death, 1989–1994
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Gordon's death in June 1991, within three years: your late nights and unsettled moving between homes through the late eighties, your wrist injury stopping your playing in October 1991 and the blow-up with Rafe that followed, your retreat into fixing radios and getting high, your anxiety and loss of direction through 1992, and your stung feeling about your father not knowing your film work in 1994. Your grandmother Winifred's thyroid surgery within a year of his death sits alongside these months. Your move to Lisbon and return to your degree in early 1994 is where the period settles, and your earlier anxieties about chess and debate sit outside it, as they belong to the ordinary level of your secondary school years.

clusters.name: Your separation from Joelle, 1998–1999
clusters.reason: Around your bonding with Joelle in January 1998 and your separation in July 1999, within two years: your insomnia began getting in the way before concerts in 1999, and you were playing the best you ever had and winning competitions for a couple of years at the same time. Within months of the split, you started with a therapist. These shifts pile up around the same time as the relationship turned, and no one else's shifts show in those months.

clusters.name: Your grandmother Winifred's bowel cancer, 2001–2004
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Winifred's bowel cancer diagnosis in 2001 or 2002, within three years: your running out of steam for performing and rising anxiety through 2001 and 2002, your disastrous audition and decision to leave performing, your distance from your parents and leaving Thornbury for Gull Harbour, your bonding with Marisol in early 2003 and swift separation within months, your sinking into deep depression once you split and returned to Thornbury in the winter of 2003. Your growing reliance on friends Silas, Corbin and Dale through late 2003, your requesting help from your parents with therapy costs in January 2004, and your return to Victor Halloran all sit in these months. Your grandmother's death in February 2004 is where the period settles. Your anxiety and distance on poor terms with family are the core of these shifts, and they reached from the audition through your recovery with your therapist.

clusters.name: Your grandmother Lorna's death, 2008
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Lorna's death in January 2008, within months: your time at Alder Creek building with Silas in July 2008, when you were too drained for conversation with your mother and she pressed to visit you despite your repeated refusal, the conflict when you kept the door shut on her, and your cutoff from your mother when you moved to nursing school in August 2008 and stopped speaking to her. Your aunt Imogen's stroke in January 2009 and the birth of your partner Leo's children in 2010 sit in the months after. The silence with your mother held for roughly a year, and you began the nursing programme in September 2008.

clusters.name: Your marriage to Wren, 2017–2019
clusters.reason: Around your marriage to Wren in March 2017, within two and a half years: you saw your mother a bit less once Wren came along, your cousin Alice diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in October 2017, your sister Tara's wedding the previous summer and her baby on the way in late 2019. Your anxiety and the constantly driving feeling about projects forward, starting a sleeping pill in October 2019, your aiming for shorter regular calls with your mother to soften the distance, all sit in these months. Your partner Wren swamped in late October 2019 around a street party, fundraising dinner and her mother's retirement party, your overfunctioning when you laid out a plan for her, her fusion with her father Hugo and brother Leo, and your awake from the small hours at the lake weekend with no more sleep and feeling you don't belong. The shifts pile up in the months around Wren's family gathering, and your anxiety shifted down once the weekend had a plan, though it rose again at the lake house.
